title: Report: Penix, Njoku among targets used in fraud

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Report: Penix, Njoku among targets used in fraud
sources.description: A former Alabama defensive end is accused of using wigs and fake IDs to impersonate NFL players to secure nearly $20 million in fraudulent loans, with a report identifying Michael Penix Jr., David Njoku and Xavier McKinney as the targeted players.
